name: Animal Science (BS)
totalCreditsNote: 120 cr per the 2026-27 catalog, plus 100 letter-graded and 105 structured credits. Confirm with your advisor.
footnote: Major courses require D- or better; at most 6 S/U or non-graded credits count. Pre-Veterinary Medicine instead requires C- or better in all major coursework and a cumulative GPA of 2.8. Grade thresholds and the S/U cap need advisor review. No course may fill two major requirements, except ANSC 2500 for core Animal Management and the Dairy prerequisite. ANSC cross-listed courses count toward the 36-credit minimum; use the ANSC code when available. Cornell credit origin is not tracked. At most 6 of the 36 ANSC credits may overlap another major and 3 may overlap a minor. AP, IB and dual-enrollment credits cannot satisfy core coursework; advisor-approved credits may satisfy concentrations. Transfer substitutions require CALS acceptance, a degree-audit entry and advisor/department approval; ANSC/BIOAP substitutions require petition review. Sophomore transfers need 36 Cornell Animal Science credits and may petition to replace one core science and Animal Management course. Junior transfers need 26 Cornell ANSC credits, waive ANSC 1101, ANSC 1105 and Ethics, complete three of the four core sciences, and arrange concentration waivers with their advisor. Both may substitute approved transferred statistics and sustainability courses. Transfer ANSC credits do not count toward Cornell ANSC minimums. Declare one concentration with faculty advisor approval at the end of the second year. Internal transfers must first earn C or better in BIOAP 1100, ANSC 2120, ANSC 2210 or ANSC 2400. Optional BS/DVM pathway: complete university, college and core requirements, including BIOAP 1100 for transfers; 108 academic credits before senior year; 33 Animal Science credits with at most 3 Special Studies credits; CVM acceptance; advisor-planned concentration; at most 12 first-semester professional credits toward 120 (within the 60-transfer-credit limit). Consult CALS and faculty advisors early in sophomore year and apply in junior year. Transfer and accelerated-pathway exceptions are notes, not automatic checklist adjustments.

sections.title: Core Coursework
sections.note: 30 core credits. DLS-AG statistics courses and SCH-AG courses also qualify for the corresponding rows. ANSC 1101 and ANSC 1105 are waived for transfers; other transfer waivers require advisor review.

sections.title: Physical Education
sections.note: Two PE classes plus the swim test, a university requirement. PE credits do not count toward the 120.

sections.title: Biology Requisites
sections.note: Maintain a cumulative GPA of at least 2.8 and C- or better in all major coursework. An approved transferred general biology course with lab (at least 4 credits, one semester or two quarters) may substitute.

sections.title: General and Organic Chemistry
sections.note: Two general chemistry courses with labs (8 credits) and at least 3 organic chemistry credits. CHEM 3580 and CHEM 2510 are recommended for veterinary-school prerequisites.

sections.title: Biochemistry
sections.note: At least 4 credits. The two-semester BIOMG 3310 and BIOMG 3320 sequence is recommended; veterinary-school prerequisites vary.

sections.title: Physics I and II with Lab
Dairy Management Requisites
sections.note: ANSC 2500 is a required prerequisite and may also meet core Animal Management. The app cannot share one course between two major rows; confirm the shared core row manually with your advisor. The Dairy Fellows Program provides engaged and applied dairy-industry experiences.

sections.title: Additional Courses

checks.title: Animal Science Credits
checks.missText: Needs 36 Animal Science credits, including BIOAP 1100 and ANSC cross-listings. Enter a cross-listed course under its ANSC code (for example ANSC 3300, not BIOAP 3300) so it counts, and verify Cornell origin with your advisor.

checks.title: Animal Science Credits Outside Special Studies
checks.missText: Needs 33 credits outside ANSC 4960, 4970, 4980 and 4990 so at most 3 Special Studies credits contribute to the 36-credit minimum.

checks.title: Intro Life Sciences/Biology
checks.missText: needs 6 credits of BIO-AG courses (BIO-AS doesn't count).

checks.title: Chemistry/Physics
checks.missText: needs 3 credits of CHPH-AG, or a CHEM or PHYS course numbered 1100+.

checks.title: Quantitative Literacy
checks.missText: needs one MQL-AG or MATH 1100+ course (an AP Calculus 4 or 5 also counts).

checks.title: Physical & Life Sciences
checks.missText: needs 18 credits, including the biology, chemistry/physics and quantitative literacy courses above.

checks.title: Human Diversity
checks.missText: needs one D-AG course of 3+ credits (SCD-AS, SCD-HA and D-HE also count).

checks.title: Social Sciences & Humanities
checks.missText: needs 3 more courses so the 4 (with Human Diversity) span 3+ categories, with at most 2 from one department. Humanities courses need 3+ credits. The app doesn't check those limits.

checks.title: Written & Oral Expression
checks.missText: needs 9 credits of writing (FWS or WRT-AG), at least 6 written; one ORL-AG course may count.

checks.title: CALS Credits
checks.missText: needs 55 credits of CALS courses (INFO and AEM count).
